scenes.narration: I studied Information Systems at the University of Nevada, Reno, and built websites for the university. Then at Bridgepointe, I assessed twenty-five client business processes and learned the most important skill in sales: listen first, then recommend.

scenes.narration: At Sierra Angels, I evaluated more than forty early-stage startups. It taught me how buyers actually make decisions, and what a strong business case looks like.
